basic_info.description: First Come First Serve no lottery. 1 bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 120% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person = $125,900; 2 = $143,900; 3 = $161,800; 4 = $179,800; 5= $194,200 etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Updated 4/4/2025, the lottery list has been exhausted.  Applications are being accepted on a first come, first served basis starting on 4/11/2025 at 8:00 AM PST. Any applications uploaded prior to 8:00 AM PT on 4/11/2025 will automatically be deleted and considered an invalid application for the first come, first served process. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Fair Housing Opportunity.
